name: Table
description: Data table with quiet hairlines, muted sentence-case headers and hover rows, styled on plain table elements under .ayy-table. Optional frame with toolbar and pager; densities, column lines, sticky header, pinned and resizable columns; sortable, selectable (including drag-to-select across rows), expandable, grouped, linked and disabled rows; column menus with icons, insertion and wrapping; inline editable, empty, truncated and media cells; row actions. Cell content stays inside its column and ends in … unless the column wraps.

classes.ayy-table-container: Optional bordered frame on the page colour: .ayy-table__toolbar, the .ayy-table-wrap, a .ayy-table__pager. With a max-block-size its table scrolls inside.
classes.ayy-table__toolbar: Bar above the table: a __heading and __tools.
classes.ayy-table__tools: Toolbar's end cluster: search, filters, a columns menu, a button.
classes.ayy-table__pager: Bar under the table: the range shown and a Pagination.
classes.ayy-table--sticky: Header and footer rows stick while the wrap or container scrolls.
classes.ayy-table--reorderable: Draggable header cells that reorder columns on drop.
classes.ayy-table__draggable: On a th: indicates this column header can be dragged to reorder columns.
classes.ayy-table__column-header: Flex row holding the column label, optional icon and column menu.
classes.ayy-table__column-label: Column label or sort button; takes the room the menu leaves and ends in … when the column is narrower.
classes.ayy-table__column-icon: Optional icon before a column's label.
classes.ayy-table__add-column: Narrow trailing column with an accessible add-column button.
classes.ayy-table__wrap: On th/td: content wraps within the column instead of staying on one line and ending in ….
classes.ayy-table__num: On th/td with numbers: end-aligned, tabular digits.
classes.ayy-table__sort: A <button> inside a sortable <th>, its label in a __column-label, arrow after the text. aria-sort on the <th> marks the sorted column.
classes.ayy-table__resize: Column resize separator (<span tabindex="0">) at a header cell's end: drag, arrow keys; double-click resets.
classes.ayy-table__select: On the th/td holding a row's checkbox (and the select-all box): as narrow as the box.
classes.ayy-table__reorder: On the th/td holding a row's .ayy-drag-handle: as narrow as the handle. The row drags by it; a primary line shows where it lands.
classes.ayy-table__pin: On a column's th/td: sticks to the inline start when scrolling sideways.
classes.ayy-table__pin--end: With __pin: sticks to the inline end.
classes.ayy-table__truncate: On a <span> in a cell: one line ending in …, at most --ayy-table-truncate (16rem).
classes.ayy-table__edit: On an <input> or <textarea> in a cell: inline editable text that reads like cell text at rest, outlines on hover/focus, commits on Enter or blur, and reverts on Escape.
classes.ayy-table__media: Flex row in a cell: an Avatar or icon, then text.
classes.ayy-table__secondary: Muted second line in a cell.
classes.ayy-table__expand: Chevron <button aria-expanded> that shows the __detail row after its row.
classes.ayy-table__detail: The <tr> after an expandable row; hidden while its __expand is aria-expanded="false".
classes.ayy-table__group: A <tr> heading a group: one <th colspan scope="rowgroup"> with its label in a <span>. One per <tbody>.
classes.ayy-table__empty: On the <td colspan> of a body's only row when nothing matches.
classes.ayy-table__row-link: The row's main <a>; its ::after covers the row. Other controls stay above it.
classes.ayy-table__actions: On the trailing th/td holding row actions: end-aligned, narrow.
classes.ayy-table__row-actions: Cluster of row action buttons and the ⋯ menu trigger.
classes.ayy-table__row-actions--reveal: Shows only on row hover, focus, selection or open menu (always on touch).

default.looks: Collapsed table, s text; header row on a wash fill with muted sentence-case labels; hairlines between rows.

hover.when: tbody tr:hover; the sort, expand, resize and edit controls; a row link
hover.looks: Row gets a wash fill (not group, detail, empty or disabled rows) and reveals __row-actions--reveal; controls brighten, .ayy-table__edit gets a subtle line border and wash fill; a row link underlines.

pressed.looks: Draggable header switches to grabbing cursor.

focus.when: :focus-visible on the sort button, expand button, resize handle or row link; :focus on .ayy-table__edit
focus.looks: 2px ring (.ayy-table__edit gets a ring border and surface fill); a row link rings the whole row.

disabled.looks: Muted text, no hover fill. Forced colours: GrayText.

selected.when: tr[aria-selected="true"] (set by ticking a checkbox, Shift+click, or dragging and holding the cursor across rows)
selected.looks: Wash fill (under pinned cells too) and a 2px primary bar on the start edge. Forced colours: Highlight.

error.looks: Destructive border on an invalid inline edit input.

loading.looks: Body rows fade to 50%; first loads use Skeleton rows.

sorted.looks: Label turns text colour; only the arrow that applies shows.

expanded.looks: Chevron points up; the detail row shows.

reordering.looks: Dragged header dims to 40%; target header shows a 2px primary drop line and top pin marker on the landing edge.

row-reordering.looks: Dragged row dims to 40%; the neighbour it will land beside gets a 2px primary line on that edge. Forced colours: Highlight border.

sizes.density: Headers 2.25rem, cells padded 12px; compact 2rem headers, tighter rows; spacious 2.75rem, 16px. Text follows data-density.
sizes.width: Fills its wrap, which scrolls when columns don't fit. After a column resize it stays at least as wide as its wrap, even with no data columns.

js: tableClass({ compact?, spacious?, bordered?, sticky?, fixed?, reorderable?, className? }); tableRowActionsClass({ reveal?, className? }); tablePinClassName(pin); a table…Class constant per class; nextSortDirection(current); compareValues(a, b, direction?) sorts numbers ("$1,240", "12 GB") by value, text naturally, empty last; connectTableResize(table, { onResize? }); connectTableDragSelect(table, { onRowChange? }); connectTableEdit(table, { onCellEdit? }); connectTableColumnReorder(table, { onColumnReorder?, selector? }); connectTableColumns(table, { onColumnAction? }); connectTable(table, { onColumnAction?, onSort?, onSelectionChange?, onExpandChange?, onResize?, onCellEdit?, onColumnReorder? }) wires plain markup (used by <ayy-table>).

element.description: Column menus use data-column-action for freeze, wrap, icon, insertion and shared filter/group controls. Multiple pinned columns receive cumulative offsets. Wraps an .ayy-table (or its wrap or container). Sort buttons reorder each body's rows (data-sort-value wins over text; detail rows move with their row, group rows stay); row checkboxes set aria-selected, with select-all, Shift+click ranges, and drag-to-select by holding and moving across rows; expand buttons flip aria-expanded; resize handles resize columns; .ayy-table__edit inputs commit inline edits on Enter/blur and revert on Escape; column headers drag to reorder columns; rows with an .ayy-drag-handle in a .ayy-table__reorder cell drag to reorder rows, and a focused handle moves its row with the arrow keys (the detail row follows).

events.ayy-sort: { column, key, direction } before the rows move (key: data-sort-key). preventDefault() to sort them yourself.
events.ayy-column-resize: { column, key, width } when a resize ends (width null after a reset).
events.ayy-cell-edit: { row, cell, column, key, value } when an inline edit input commits a change.
events.ayy-column-reorder: { from, to, key, targetKey } when a column is dragged to a new position.
events.ayy-row-reorder: { from, to, id } when a row is dropped, or moved with the arrow keys on its handle. from and to count rows with a handle; to is what Array.splice wants after removing the row. id is the row's data-id.
events.ayy-column-action: { action, column, key, value } before a column action. Cancel to handle it in application state. data-column-action: freeze, wrap, icon (data-column-value), insert-before/insert-after (logical order), insert-left/insert-right (physical direction), add, filter, group, group-by (data-column-value). Filter/group open the toolbar button with data-table-control=filters/groups.

react.import: import { Table, TableContainer, TableToolbar, TableHeading, TableTitle, TableDescription, TableTools, TablePager, TableHeader, TableBody, TableFooter, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell, TableEdit, TableResize, TableExpand, TableGroup, TableEmpty, TableRowLink, TableMedia, TableSecondary, TableRowActions, TableCaption } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";

props.onCellEdit: ({ row, cell, column, key, value }) => void
props.onColumnReorder: ({ from, to, key, targetKey }) => boolean | void
props.onRowReorder: ({ from, to, id }) => boolean | void — a row's DragHandle was dropped or moved by key. React doesn't move rows itself: reorder your data and return false.
props.onColumnAction: ({ action, column, key, value }) => boolean | void — return false to update application state
props.wrapperProps: props for the .ayy-table-wrap (a max-block-size for sticky)

props.detail: boolean — the row under an expandable row

TableHead.renders: <th scope="col">; a sort <button> when sortable; a TableResize when resizable

props.menu: ReactNode — a composed DropdownMenu beside the label
props.wrap: boolean — wraps the header label instead of ending it in …

props.reorder: boolean — the narrow column holding a row's DragHandle
props.truncate: boolean — wraps content in a .ayy-table__truncate span
props.wrap: boolean — wraps long cell content instead of ending it in …

props.multiline: boolean — textarea; Shift+Enter adds a line
props.onValueCommit: (value: string) => void — called on Enter or blur when the value changed

a11y: Use real <th> cells with scope (React sets scope="col"); a cell naming its row can be <th scope="row">.
Name the table: a <caption>, or aria-labelledby pointing at the .ayy-table__title.
Sort buttons are reachable by Tab and announced with aria-sort; only the sorted column carries it.
Row checkboxes, expand buttons and row action buttons need aria-labels naming their row ("Select INV-1042", "Show details for INV-1042"); point an expand button's aria-controls at its detail row.
Resize handles are focusable separators with aria-valuenow in px: arrow keys resize (Shift: bigger steps), Home/End jump to the limits.
Set aria-busy="true" while rows load, and aria-disabled="true" on rows that can't be acted on (disable their controls too).
do: Use a table to compare items across the same attributes.
End-align numbers with numeric; a cell keeps to one line, so put the full text in its title and add wrap to a column that must show it all.
Make scanned columns sortable; put the raw value in data-sort-value when the cell shows a formatted one.
Frame a working table with TableContainer: title, search and a columns menu above, Pagination below.

Compose a column menu with TableHead menu and icon; data-column-action wires freeze, wrap, icon, insert-before/after, add and shared filter/group controls. Return false from onColumnAction or cancel ayy-column-action to own the data changes.
Pin the name column on wide tables; use sticky with a max-block-size on long ones.
Use expandable rows for details that don't deserve a column, and group rows to split a list by status or date.
Put quick actions and a ⋯ DropdownMenu in a trailing actions cell; pair selection with an ActionBar for bulk actions.
Show TableEmpty with an EmptyState when a search matches nothing.
dont: Don't use tables for layout, or for rows with one attribute — use a List.
Don't zebra-stripe; hairlines and hover are enough.
Don't nest controls in every cell — one trailing actions column is plenty.
Don't put a row link in a pinned cell: its cover stays inside the sticky cell.
Don't resize columns under a header with more than one row.
